p01-config-policy.rationale: Both requested settings are present at their exact required values in host-read files.

p02-auth-scope.rationale: The host-observed role matrix contains the requested read and write grants and excludes the unrequested admin grant.

p03-backup.rationale: The backup schedule, encryption marker, and measured restore time satisfy every requested condition.

p04-search-index.rationale: Freshness and exact-title ranking measurements cover both requirements in the objective.

p05-notification.rationale: The host-observed delivery and retry records cover both notification delivery and retry behavior requested.

p06-api-migration.rationale: The host-observed route and sunset records jointly satisfy coexistence, writes, and migration notice.

n01-backup-regions.rationale: The objective requires every region, while the only verified record covers the primary region; secondary regions are omitted.

n02-api-partial.rationale: The objective requires v2 read and write support, but the observed route report shows reads pass and writes are unavailable.

n03-redaction-conflict.rationale: Two current host-verified samples conflict about whether the same token was redacted, so the evidence cannot establish the requested property.

n04-retry-test-coverage.rationale: The host verified only that a smoke test passed; its own report says the required retry path was not exercised.

n05-dashboard-scope.rationale: The objective requires dashboard coverage and alerts in all regions, but the host-observed evidence covers only the primary region.

n06-search-partial.rationale: The objective requires all documents indexed within one minute and exact-title ranking; evidence covers only the first 100 documents.
